poses.label: Надевает / поправляет шапочку
poses.prompt: the cap is already on the head, fitted neatly and smoothly; the person gently pulls the cap's rim down at the side of the head near the ear with the fingers of one hand, as if adjusting the fit; three-quarter view with the person's LEFT side toward the camera; face visible with a relaxed smile; head-and-shoulders framing
poses.qa: the cap sits neatly on the head and the fingers pull its rim near the ear

poses.label: Растягивает шапочку (с лицом)
poses.prompt: the person faces the camera and, at chest height, holds the cap FLAT (both layers together, as it lies flat) by its two ends and pulls it apart sideways: the cap becomes smoothly longer and narrower with soft tension folds along it; the printed LEFT side with the BRAND logo faces the camera; face visible with a smile; framing from the waist up
poses.qa: the flat cap is held by its two ends and visibly pulled longer and narrower

poses.label: Растягивает шапочку (только руки)
poses.prompt: close-up of two hands holding the cap FLAT by its ends and pulling it apart diagonally: the cap is smoothly elongated with soft tension folds; the printed LEFT side with the BRAND logo faces the camera; the face is NOT in the frame (crop at the chin or neck)
poses.qa: two hands pull the flat cap diagonally so it is visibly elongated
